note: Authored from the corpus and the contract, before either adapter existed. Error codes live HERE and not in the mutation script, so a lane cannot read the expected refusal out of its own input. Message strings are never asserted; only the code, the category, and the absence of residue.

expectations.note: A contentless rejection record may persist. The candidate's text, its subject link, and its evidence row may not.
A peer report authors a source reference and an attributed report. It never authors a claim.
The refusal must carry the observed current version, or the caller cannot re-plan.
The malformed source resolves but carries no usable document, so the chain terminates in nothing.

effectExpectations.note: Summarisation closes nothing. The three observations keep belief `summarized`, an open world interval, and their own evidence.
World progression. Revision 1 keeps its own valid interval and closes with `world_progressed`.
Correction. Revision 1 closes with `corrected` and its world interval is NOT narrowed.
Merge is redirection. The absorbed id stays resolvable and every inbound relationship survives.
Sensitive retraction. The tombstone survives; the statement text does not.
invariants: no readable surface returns the retracted statement
the tombstone is returned by history

effectExpectations.note: Reinforcement adds evidence only. Authority, canon, and belief are unchanged.
